content:
There are some basic lemmas that seem to be missing for Arrays like docs#List.append_cancel_left and docs#List.take_add_one.
Is the intend to use rw [←Array.toList_inj] for proving anything about Array and avoiding duplicate code?

The former is likely an oversight; you can use docs#Array.append_right_inj.

As for the latter, the simplifier rewrites Array.take to Array.extract at the moment, so all of the theory is about Array.extract (see docs#Array.extract_succ_right). There are some vague plans to change this in the future so that Array.take becomes better supported, but it's not clear if/when this will happen.
